verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs cover only note-level linking: `[[` links between notes, auto-created linked notes, and backlinks as lists of incoming links. Nothing in the evidence shows referencing or transcluding an individual block or section with live sync. Note-level links are an adjacent feature and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reference or transclude an individual block or section of one note inside another and have it stay in sync
